state_codes.table_description: Reference table mapping 2-digit state codes to state names. Used to resolve place_of_supply and supplier/buyer state codes.

columns.state_code: 2-digit code assigned by GST council. E.g., '27' = Maharashtra, '07' = Delhi, '29' = Karnataka.
columns.state_name: Full name of the Indian state or union territory.
columns.state_type: 'State' for full states, 'UT' for union territories like Chandigarh or Ladakh.

hsn_master.table_description: Reference table for Harmonized System of Nomenclature codes. Maps goods/services codes to descriptions and default tax rates.

columns.hsn_code: 4 to 8 digit code identifying a commodity. First 2 digits = chapter (e.g., '84' = machinery), first 4 = heading.
columns.description: Human-readable description of the goods or service category.
columns.chapter: First 2 digits of the HSN code indicating the broad product chapter.
columns.default_tax_rate: Default GST rate for this HSN: 0, 5, 12, 18, or 28 percent.

suppliers.table_description: Master table of GST-registered suppliers (sellers) who file GSTR-1 returns.

columns.gstin: 15-character GST Identification Number. Format: 2-digit state code + 10-char PAN + entity number + check digit.
columns.legal_name: Registered legal name of the business entity.
columns.trade_name: Trade or brand name, may differ from legal name. Can be NULL.
columns.state_code: 2-digit state code of the supplier's registration state.
columns.state_name: Full name of the supplier's registration state.
columns.registration_type: 'Regular' (standard taxpayer), 'Composition' (simplified scheme for small businesses, pays flat rate).
columns.created_at: Date the supplier registered under GST.

buyers.table_description: Master table of buyers (customers). B2B buyers are GST-registered; B2C and export buyers may not be.

columns.gstin: GSTIN of the buyer. NULL for unregistered B2C buyers (B2CS category).
columns.legal_name: Name of the buying entity. Can be NULL for anonymous B2C transactions.
columns.state_code: 2-digit state code of the buyer's location. Used to determine intra-state vs inter-state supply.
columns.state_name: Full name of the buyer's state.
columns.buyer_type: 'B2B' = registered business buyer; 'B2CL' = unregistered buyer with invoice > 2.5 lakh; 'B2CS' = unregistered buyer with invoice <= 2.5 lakh; 'EXPORT' = overseas buyer.

invoices.table_description: Core transaction table. Each row is one GST invoice filed under GSTR-1 return by a supplier.

columns.invoice_number: Supplier-assigned invoice number. Unique per supplier.
columns.invoice_type: 'B2B' = business-to-business supply; 'B2CL' = B2C large (inter-state, value > 2.5 lakh); 'B2CS' = B2C small; 'EXPORT' = export supply; 'CDNR' = credit/debit note for registered buyer; 'CDNUR' = credit/debit note for unregistered buyer.
columns.buyer_id: Foreign key to buyers table. NULL for B2CS (anonymous small B2C transactions).
columns.place_of_supply: 2-digit state code where the supply is deemed to occur. If same as supplier state = intra-state (CGST+SGST applies). If different = inter-state (IGST applies).
columns.reverse_charge: TRUE if tax liability is on the buyer instead of the supplier (Section 9(3) or 9(4) of CGST Act 2017).
columns.invoice_value: Total invoice amount including all taxes (taxable_value + CGST + SGST + IGST + cess).
columns.return_period: MMYYYY format filing period. E.g., '032026' = March 2026, '012026' = January 2026.
columns.filing_status: 'Filed' = submitted to GST portal; 'Pending' = not yet filed; 'Amended' = revised after original filing.

invoice_items.table_description: Line items within each invoice. Each invoice has 1 or more items with individual tax breakup.

columns.hsn_code: HSN/SAC code for this line item. First 2 digits = chapter.
columns.description: Description of goods or service for this line item.
columns.unit: Unit of measurement (UQC): 'KGS' = kilograms, 'NOS' = numbers/units, 'MTR' = metres, 'LTR' = litres, 'SQM' = square metres.
columns.taxable_value: Value of supply before adding tax. GST is calculated on this amount.
columns.cgst_amount: Central GST = taxable_value × (tax_rate / 2) / 100. Non-zero ONLY for intra-state supplies (supplier state = place_of_supply).
columns.sgst_amount: State GST = taxable_value × (tax_rate / 2) / 100. Always equals CGST. Non-zero ONLY for intra-state supplies.
columns.igst_amount: Integrated GST = taxable_value × tax_rate / 100. Non-zero ONLY for inter-state supplies or exports. Cannot be non-zero simultaneously with CGST/SGST.
columns.cess_amount: Compensation cess on top of GST. Applicable on luxury/sin goods (e.g., tobacco, aerated drinks, vehicles).

export_invoices.table_description: Additional details for EXPORT-type invoices (GSTR-1 Table 6). Linked to invoices table.

columns.invoice_id: Foreign key to invoices table. Only EXPORT-type invoices have a row here.
columns.port_code: 6-character Indian customs port code from where goods were exported.
columns.shipping_bill_no: Shipping bill number issued by customs. Required for claiming export benefits.
columns.export_type: 'WITH_PAYMENT' = IGST paid on export (can claim refund); 'WITHOUT_PAYMENT' = exported under bond/LUT with zero IGST.
